notes: Tuition fees were not extracted: the pages state fees only per ISEE (income-based) without giving both a lowest and highest amount for a non-EU applicant whose household is abroad, and no country-group reduced-fee quote names Morocco. Both the 'reduced fixed fee' pages state the reduced fee applies to citizens of particularly poor/developing or non-OECD countries; the non-OECD country list PDF includes Morocco, but no same-year figure page names Morocco alongside an amount, so per the task rules tuition is left out. Candidature: several selections exist (first/second/extraordinary) but the pages give no dated application window with a year for non-EU applicants residing abroad, so no intake was written.
